record.question: Which quality control measure is used to check if the capsules release the contents properly in the GI tract?
record.explanation: Answer C: Disintegration test. Disintegration testing assesses whether a capsule dosage unit breaks up under specified conditions; dissolution testing would more directly measure drug release, but is not offered. Source/context note: Capsule content release is more directly tested by dissolution; disintegration is only the closest offered choice. Reference: https://www.usp.org/compounding/general-chapter-disintegration-and-dissolution. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
